ANNUAL REPORT PURSUANT TO SECTION 13 OR 15(d) OF THE SECURITIES EXCHANGE ACT OF 1934

Item 4. Information on the Company

B. Business Overview

We have partnered with the Nasdaq Stock Market and the New York Stock Exchange to launch advanced U.S. stock Level II market data. Currently, our eligible clients globally can enjoy free U.S. stock Level II market data on Futubull or Moomoo. Additionally, we offer free real-time Level II market data for dozens of cryptocurrencies. We also offer a variety of advanced stock quote services to our clients, for which we charge a monthly fee.
